{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Check if any QA orders are present (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_orders)}')

# If any QA orders, drop them
if len(qa_orders) > 0:
    completed_orders_clean = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]
    mean_revenue_clean = completed_orders_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()
    print(f'Mean revenue (excluding QA orders): {mean_revenue_clean:.2f}')
else:
    print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}')

# Final answer
mean_revenue_final = mean_revenue
if len(qa_orders) > 0:
    mean_revenue_final = mean_revenue_clean

print(f'Final mean revenue: {mean_revenue_final:.2f}')"}
